title: Glitch / Animated symbol

location.extent: Representative frame; complete local motion provided

slide_intent: Carry a compact identifier through color and scale changes so viewers can recognize the brand without reading its name.
strategic_value: The speech-bubble-like Glitch can provide Twitch recognition in spaces where the full wordmark is unnecessary.
demonstration: A white-and-black Glitch symbol changes scale and briefly changes its inner marks against purple and gradient backgrounds.
practical_value: Compare how much expression a compact symbol can carry while preserving its silhouette.

content_islands.spec: Keep Glitch isolated near the center with its angular outline and black depth.

content_islands.name: Changing field
content_islands.spec: Alternate purple and multicolor backgrounds while the symbol scales and changes internal details.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip animates the Glitch symbol while maintaining its recognizable angular outline.
